newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers gain $1/$2, other ports follow.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers gain $1/$2, other ports follow.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers gained by around $1/$2 a tonne as barges increased, and prices in the rest of Europe increased by a similar amount, dealers said.
Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $88/$89 fob towards the market close.
Total ARA bunker demand was far lower than Tuesday's impressive 25,000 tonnes. Dealers said enquiries rose by midday, but few deals were concluded in the afternoon.
Hamburg bunkers also rose by $1/$2 to around $91/$92 fob. German demand was also thin.

Benchmark quotes rose by $1 for fuel oil and gas oil. French prices went up $2 as enquiries mounted. Spanish fuel oil bunkers were up about $1 a tonne, but Italian prices were steady as competition among sellers remained keen.
"We're just keen to move material at the moment," said one supplier.
